title: Cycle-Accurate Execution Timing
body:
Each instruction shall consume the exact number of clock cycles as the real MOS 6510, including the extra cycle for page-boundary crossings on indexed addressing modes, the extra cycle for taken branches, and the additional cycle for page-crossing branches. The CPU shall expose its internal pipeline state (fetch, decode, execute sub-cycles) to allow other devices to observe and react at sub-instruction granularity.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Every opcode consumes exactly the documented cycle count (per the "MOS 6510 Unintended Opcodes" reference and 64doc.txt).
- Page-boundary crossing adds exactly one cycle for absolute indexed reads (LDA abs,X / LDA abs,Y / LDA (zp),Y).
- Page-boundary crossing on write instructions (STA abs,X) always takes the extra cycle regardless of whether a page boundary is actually crossed.
- Taken branches add one cycle; taken branches crossing a page boundary add two cycles.
- The `IClockedDevice.Tick()` method is invoked once per clock phase, and CPU sub-cycle state is observable via `ICpu.Phase`.
- The CIA/VIC-II timing interleave passes the VICE timing test suite.
